lines.en: My hooves strike the dry soil.

lines.zh: 骑士在我背上一动不动。
lines.en: The rider on my back sits motionless.
I move forward with a rolling gait.
I go around a stretch of rubble.
The clatter of iron follows me.
I walk slowly toward you.
I toss my head; my mane is stiff.
I keep along the roadside.
My hoofprints are shallow.
I stop and wait for the rider's word.
I take two more iron-shod steps.

lines.zh: 我的蹄印浅，因为没有重量。
lines.en: My hoofprints are shallow; I carry no weight.

lines.zh: 我站着，鞍上的骑士不动。
lines.en: I stand; the rider in the saddle is still.

lines.zh: 我喷了一口气，没有白雾。
lines.en: I snort, and no mist comes.
My bones creak under my hide.
The armor knocks once in a while.

lines.zh: 我低下头，看到自己的肋骨。
lines.en: I lower my head and see my own ribs.
I paw the ground with one hoof.
The shield on the saddle catches light.
My steed is down to bare bone.
I swish my tail, stiffly.
There's little living here.
You stand before my reins.
I raise my eyes to you.
The rider has raised the axe.
You shouldn't stand here.

lines.zh: 骑士的斧柄挡住了我一半视线。
lines.en: The rider's axe haft blocks half my view.
Your scent is fresh.

lines.zh: 我不知道骑士在想什么。
lines.en: I don't know what the rider thinks.

lines.zh: 我们两个共用一副身体。
lines.en: We two share one body.
My teeth are the same teeth as before.
Don't touch my saddle.
A cut has opened in my hide.

lines.zh: 这一下打到了我的骨头。
lines.en: That struck bone.

lines.zh: 我的骨头错开，又自己卡回。
lines.en: My bones shift apart, then click back.
I scarcely feel pain.
The rider pats my neck.
I swish my stiff tail.
My bones creak louder.
I can keep running.

lines.zh: 斧刃上还挂着你的气味。
lines.en: Your scent still clings to the axe edge.
We're still standing.
That smells like fodder.

lines.zh: 我这匹马，蹄子没有温度。
lines.en: My horse's hooves carry no warmth.
I've no appetite for eating.
The rider's boot nudges me.
I take one step toward it.

lines.zh: 那果子的甜味，穿过我的鼻腔。
lines.en: The fruit's sweetness passes right through my nostrils.
I look, then lift my head.

lines.zh: 你把它放地上，我踩过去。
lines.en: Set it down and I'll walk over it.
That hay smell can't pull me.
The rider signals me not to stop.
You hit my chest and fell back.
This frame of mine won't budge.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子在你脚边落下。
lines.en: My hooves land beside your feet.

lines.zh: 我一个侧身，你就被挡开。
lines.en: One turn and you're brushed off.
The two of us press in together.
The iron armor gives a dull knock.

lines.zh: 我的肩胛骨比你的盾还硬。
lines.en: My shoulder blade is harder than your shield.
That bump means nothing.
I walk on.

lines.zh: 骑士的斧子已经抬高了。
lines.en: The rider's axe has risen.

lines.zh: 另一匹僵尸马站在远处。
lines.en: Another zombie horse stands far off.
We both carry riders.
We walk the slope side by side.
Its saddle is worn too.
Our hoofbeats merge.
The two riders look at each other, silent.
We need no pasture.
We walk until dawn.
My bones knock against its.
Tomorrow we'll ride on together.
I lower my head and take it in my teeth.
This is heavy.

lines.zh: 我叼起那东西，牙咬不稳。
lines.en: I pick it up, but my teeth won't hold.
I walked over it.
It's stuck between my hooves.
I carry it onward.
The rider reached down and took it.
I look at it a long while.
No taste; I spit it into the dirt.
This I can't carry off.
The rider has tightened the reins.
I know to go forward.
My eye sockets swing to you.
I lower my head, ready to charge.

lines.zh: 这条路我记得，是我们一起走的。
lines.en: I know this road; we rode it together.
You have nowhere to retreat.
All four hooves start moving.
The two of us go together.
The axe is raised.

lines.zh: 骑士的靴跟磕了一下，就是现在。
lines.en: The rider's heel taps — now.
What the horse's nostrils blow is cold.
I charge straight at you.
This road has no other turn.
We work well together.

lines.zh: 你站在我鼻尖前面，没有退。
lines.en: You stand before my nose and don't step back.
I bear down hoof by hoof.
You run; I follow on four hooves.

lines.zh: 我算着鞍上骑士的呼吸。
lines.en: I time my steps to the rider's breath.
The rider sits steady on my back.
The road shortens underfoot.
I looped around.
Your breath is wilder than my hooves.

lines.zh: 我离你只剩一蹄的距离。
lines.en: I'm one hoof-length from you.
My hoofbeats are loud.
You're squeezed against the wall.
I'm ready to charge.
The rider's axe is ready.
We both come at you.
Good, this position.

lines.zh: 铁甲僵尸骑在马上，压低身子。
lines.en: Armored zombie on horseback, crouched low.
One more stride.
My hind hooves kick and clods fly.

lines.zh: 四蹄离了地，我撞进你怀里。
lines.en: All four hooves leave the ground; I slam into you.
The iron armor sounds dull.
I plant a hoof on you.
The rider's axe falls at the same time.

lines.zh: 我的马披着鞍，冲起来不停。
lines.en: My saddled horse charges without stopping.
I rear my forelegs up.
The iron sounds dull.
I pull back and charge again.
This isn't the first time.
I wrench my head and throw you off.
The rider's shield blocked once.
Dust comes up from the ground.
We draw back again.
My bones are still creaking.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子压在你胸口上。
lines.en: My hoof rests on your chest.

lines.zh: 我从侧面撞开你的护架。
lines.en: I slam in and break your guard.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子压住了你的脚。
lines.en: My hoof pins your foot.
I step out of the shadow.
The hoofbeats come first, then me.
The Zombie Horseman has come.
The rider in the saddle sits upright.
Two points of corpse-light glow.
I come around a dead tree.
The two of us appear together.
Dust rises under my hooves.
The iron armor knocks once.
This road is ours to walk now.
I raise my head and look ahead.
The rider said nothing.
I snort once more.
I walk slowly to the middle of the road.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的干皮，焦味很冲。
lines.en: Fire sears my dried hide with a sharp stink.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，骑士也翻下了鞍。
lines.en: I go down, and the rider falls from the saddle.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的口鼻，我挣不动。
lines.en: Water covers my muzzle and I can't free myself.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的鞍也掀歪了。
lines.en: The blast knocks my saddle askew.
An arrow lodges in my neck.
The light leaves me unsteady.

lines.zh: 这具身子早就不知道饿了。
lines.en: This body forgot hunger long ago.

lines.zh: 雷顺着铁甲爬到我骨头上。
lines.en: Lightning crawls down the armor into my bones.
Nothing under my hooves, and still I kick.
